description: Type stub for torch.distributed.rpc module, defining classes, functions, and constants related to distributed RPC in PyTorch.

classes.name: RpcBackendOptions
classes.description: Base class for RPC backend options, including rpc_timeout and init_method.

classes.name: WorkerInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a worker in the distributed RPC setup, including name and id.

classes.name: RpcAgent
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for an RPC agent, including methods for joining, syncing, shutting down, and retrieving worker info.

classes.name: PyRRef
classes.description: Represents a remote reference to a Python object, supporting ownership, serialization, and remote method invocation.

classes.name: _TensorPipeRpcBackendOptionsBase
classes.description: Configuration options for TensorPipe RPC backend, including device maps and worker threads.

classes.name: TensorPipeAgent
classes.description: Implementation of RpcAgent using TensorPipe backend, managing worker info, device mappings, and group membership.

classes.name: RemoteProfilerManager
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing profiling keys in remote profiling.
